name: Easy UI
summary: Free MIT micro-animated React components via official shadcn GitHub Registry.
gaps: Pilot includes 12 of 106 registry items in Surajmaurya1/easyui registry.json — not a full inventory.
Installed via shadcn GitHub Registry namespace Surajmaurya1/easyui/<slug>; live site has no /r/{slug}.json — catalog registryUrl uses GitHub public/source/{slug}.json (HTTP 200).
Site /components/pricing is a Pricing *component* demo (Free $0 / Pro $29 UI cards), not a library paywall — pricing catalogued as free.
Import path after CLI: @/components/ui/{slug} (README); source files use PascalCase under src/components/ui/.
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.
glitch-text: tagged text-scramble for matrix variant; other glitch modes have no dedicated EffectType enum.

components.name: Magnetic Button
components.summary: Button with proximity-based physics that pulls toward the cursor on hover.
components.copyCode:
npx shadcn@latest add Surajmaurya1/easyui/magnetic-button

import { MagneticButton } from "@/components/ui/magnetic-button"

<MagneticButton />

copyPrompt.text: Use Easy UI free component `Magnetic Button` (slug `magnetic-button`) from https://www.easyui.site/components/magnetic-button. Install with `npx shadcn@latest add Surajmaurya1/easyui/magnetic-button` after `npx shadcn@latest init`. Registry item: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Surajmaurya1/easyui/main/public/source/magnetic-button.json. Import path after CLI follows project aliases (see docs). Requires React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS; peers: Needs framer-motion.. License: MIT (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Surajmaurya1/easyui/main/LICENSE). Free open-source shadcn GitHub Registry (Surajmaurya1/easyui); site Pricing page is a demo UI component (Free $0 / Pro $29 cards), not a paid unlock for the library — all ingested comps are free MIT.
